2607.12711.title: MaxSAT-Based Feedback for Guiding Vision-Language Models in Sudoku
2607.12711.paper_summary: Vision--Language Models (VLMs) have recently demonstrated promising performance on structured visual reasoning tasks, including grid-based puzzles. However, despite strong perceptual capabilities, these models lack explicit mechanisms for enforcing logical consistency and frequently generate assignments that violate underlying constraints. In this paper, we propose a neuro-symbolic approach that integrates formal constraint reasoning into the VLM solving process via a Maximum Satisfiability (MaxSAT) oracle. Rather than computing solutions directly, the symbolic component acts as a consistency validator and refinement engine. Candidate placements generated by the VLM are encoded as soft clauses in a partial MaxSAT formulation, while Sudoku constraints remain hard clauses. When inconsistencies arise, the MaxSAT solver identifies a largest mutually consistent subset of assignments, which is then translated into structured textual and visual feedback to guide subsequent refinements. We evaluate our approach on a Sudoku dataset across multiple open-source and closed-access VLMs. Results show that MaxSAT-based feedback improves logical consistency and increases the number of solved instances, particularly in full-board refinement mode. These findings demonstrate that symbolic optimisation can enhance the reliability of vision-language reasoning.
2607.12711.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言模型（VLMs）最近在結構化視覺推理任務上展示了令人鼓舞的表現，包括基於網格的謎題。<lb/>然而，儘管具備強大的感知能力，這些模型缺乏明確的機制來強制執行邏輯一致性，並且經常生成違反基本約束的分配。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了一種神經符號方法，通過最大滿足性（MaxSAT）預言機將形式約束推理整合到VLM解決過程中。<lb/>這種方法並不是直接計算解，而是將符號組件作為一致性驗證器和精煉引擎。<lb/>VLM生成的候選放置被編碼為部分MaxSAT公式中的軟子句，而數獨約束則保持為硬子句。<lb/>當出現不一致時，MaxSAT求解器識別出最大的相互一致的分配子集，然後將其轉換為結構化的文本和視覺反饋，以指導後續的精煉。<lb/>我們在多個開源和閉源的VLM上評估了我們的方法，使用數獨數據集。<lb/>結果顯示，基於MaxSAT的反饋改善了邏輯一致性並增加了解決的實例數，特別是在全盤精煉模式下。<lb/>這些發現表明，符號優化可以增強視覺-語言推理的可靠性。
